author: GameTrailers
description:
Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic's Space Program DLC is available now on PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG). Watch the Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic Space Program launch trailer for this DLC update, which lets you spread socialism to space in this strategy city-builder game. 

In Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic, build a soviet republic from an impoverished country into a rich industrial superpower in a city builder with intricate production chains and a fully simulated global economy. Manage the lives of your citizens from education to work and party loyalty to criminal activity.
title: Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic - Official Space Program Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Meet the Smart Gun in this latest trailer for Worms: Galactic Tactics, an upcoming 3D turn-based tactical roguelike game. In Worms: Galactic Tactics, climb the ranks of the Galactic Gauntlet and take down the magnificent Emperor Flugg! 

Worms: Galactic Tactics will be available on Steam, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) in 2027.
title: Worms: Galactic Tactics - Official Weapon of the Week: Smart Gun Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take another look at gameplay and more from Hordeguard: Winds of the North in this latest trailer for the upcoming action tower defense game. Hordeguard: Winds of the North will be available on PC. A second playtest via Steam begins on December 1, 2026. New features of the second playtest include enemy raids, 10 new passive skills, a new command panel, additional language support, and more.

In Hordeguard: Winds of the North, every battle is a race against time. Gather resources, expand your settlement, and strengthen your defenses before increasingly powerful waves of mythical enemies descend upon your village. Before each assault, players must decide how far they are willing to venture from the safety of their settlement. Every resource gathered can strengthen the village, but every moment spent exploring brings the next enemy wave closer.
title: Hordeguard: Winds of the North - Official New Playtest Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a fresh look at Sovereign Tower in this latest trailer for the medieval fantasy round-table RPG. Sovereign Tower is available now on Steam, and it is coming to Nintendo Switch on January 14, 2027. The Nintendo Switch version will bring all post-launch PC updates and improvements, including a major narrative overhaul, a new Hard Mode, and fixes and quality-of-life improvements.

As Sovereign of the Tower, players will recruit a cadre of questionably heroic Knights to fulfil even more questionable quests. Each Knight has their own strengths and weaknesses and players must send their best suited Knights to recover lost relics, banish great evil and... wrangle stray geese, all while keeping their inflated egos in check, lest they meet an untimely end. 

And, when players inevitably royally mess up in one way or another? They can simply ask the Demon lurking in the crypts to rewind to a specific moment in time - maybe a beloved Knight's death? A complete lapse in judgement? An utterly
title: Sovereign Tower - Official Nintendo Switch Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest trailer for Stellaris to see what to expect from S10: Willpower, which brings the new Ideologies mechanic, 3 new origins to explore, new ideological paragons, a new ambition, new civics, a new megastructure, and more. Season 10: Willpower of Stellaris is out now.

In Season 10: Willpower, the fate of the galaxy is no longer decided by fleets alone. Ideologies are weapons, beliefs are power, and entire civilizations can be brought under your influence. 

Transform your empire's Ethics into powerful Ideologies, establish Galactic Halls to extend your reach, and reshape galactic politics through Ideological Diplomacy. With three new Origins and the Force of Will Ambition, the galaxy is yours to sway.
title: Stellaris - Official S10: Willpower Launch Trailer
